items.title: Results of Operations and Financial Condition

headline.text: Vertiv Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 with Net Sales Growth of 61%, Organic Orders Growth over 100% and Diluted EPS Growth of 91% (Adjusted Diluted EPS Growth of 78%); Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance Across All Key Metrics

outlook.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance
outlook.text:
Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance
•Expects fourth quarter 2026 net sales of $4,413 million and organic sales growth of 50%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to fourth quarter 2025.
•Expects fourth quarter 2026 diluted EPS of $2.08 and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.25, each at the midpoint of guidance, an increase of 82% and 65%, respectively, compared to fourth quarter 2025.

outlook.heading: Full Year 2026 Guidance
outlook.text:
Full Year 2026 Guidance
•Expects full year 2026 net sales of $14,650 million and organic sales growth of 38%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to full year 2025.
•Expects full year 2026 diluted EPS of $6.29 and adjusted diluted EPS of $7.15, each at the midpoint of guidance, an increase of 84% and 70%, respectively, compared to full year 2025.

outlook.heading: Updated Full Year and Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance
outlook.text:
Updated Full Year and Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance
The data center market continues to generate strong, broad-based global demand, further validating the depth and duration of the growth cycle. Vertiv continues to expand capacity and invest in next-generation technology to stay ahead of customer needs and capture an expanding opportunity set.

items.title: Results of Operations and Financial Condition

headline.text: Vertiv Reports Strong Second Quarter 2026 with Diluted EPS Growth of 53% (Adjusted Diluted EPS Growth of +60%); Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance Across All Key Metrics

outlook.heading: Full Year 2026 Guidance
outlook.text:
Full Year 2026 Guidance
•Expects full year 2026 net sales of $14,000 million and organic sales growth of 31%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to full year 2025.
•Expects full year 2026 diluted EPS of $5.82 to $5.92 and adjusted diluted EPS of $6.65 to $6.75, a midpoint increase of 72% and 60%, respectively, compared to full year 2025.

method: Each quarter's earnings release is the 8-K with Item 2.02 filed after that quarter's end (within 120 days, before the next quarter ends), the last one on or before the 10-Q/10-K for the quarter when there are several; its text is the first EX-99 exhibit. Outlook passages are the blocks under the release's own Outlook or Guidance headings; adjustments are its reconciliation tables and the notes under its figures that state a dollar amount. Quoted as written, found by fixed rules: a release without such a heading or table shows none. No beat or miss: Tributary holds no estimates.
